searches.answer: The sources highlight several trending tech topics for 2026. AI is increasingly used by traditional knowledge workers and is seen as a powerful enabler of other technologies. The Internet of Things (IoT) is expanding with miniaturization, cost-effectiveness, and 5G technology, though it raises concerns about trust and privacy. Virtual Reality (VR) is noted for its effectiveness in teaching soft skills and enabling better-than-real-life work environments. AI is converging with robotics, creating a flywheel effect where better technology enables more applications, generating more data, attracting more investment, and building better infrastructure. Frontier innovation and experimentation with new technologies like low-code development and smart consumer tech are also gaining traction. Additionally, there is a focus on post-quantum cryptography and the increasing interaction with smart robots.
